hints.title: Target Quadrant Decomposition
hints.text: Any optimal movement path aims toward one of the four cardinal quadrants.

hints.title: Net Distance Gain via Inversion
hints.text: Flipping an opposing step into a favored direction increases the net coordinate distance by 2.

hints.title: Prefix Extrema Tracking
hints.text: Evaluate the maximum distance reached across all prefixes for each of the four quadrant targets.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Scans the string 4 times for each directional quadrant with constant space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force search of all combinations of k flips has exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates directly on input sequence with constant auxiliary variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that flipping an opposing move yields a net change of plus 2 toward a targeted quadrant.
